_comment: Derived from silver_talons_red, whose printed functional text is byte-identical. Colour variants differ only in {p} and pitch, and both come from card data rather than this file, so the abilities carry over unchanged. Verified against the corpus as its own card. INHERITED NOTE FROM silver_talons_red: NOT IMPLEMENTED: 'if damage is dealt this way, the dagger HAS HIT'. 'Has hit' is the hit event, which the engine emits only for an attack that connects -- there is no way to say that an object which did not attack has hit, so a Dagger's own on-hit clauses cannot fire from here. The damage and the destroy are intact; the SET_FLAG between them is a placeholder nothing reads. The source's SET_FLAG for DAGGER_HAS_HIT was NOT copied: nothing reads that flag, so it is a clause authored to look finished while doing nothing, and tests/test_no_dead_flags.py exists to stop that spreading. The clause it stood for stays unimplemented here, as on the source.
